title: The artifact was already gone when it dealt damage
matchup: Titania's Lock against white creature aggro
story: My opponent attacked with White Knight , a 2/2 first striker. I let it through combat, then before ending the turn tapped a Plains to pay one for Aeolipile . I tapped and sacrificed the artifact as the rest of the ability's cost, targeting the Knight after combat. When it resolved, Aeolipile dealt two damage and the Knight died. My Winter Orb was still on the table. The sacrifice happened before my opponent could respond to the activation; no spell that destroyed Aeolipile afterward could bring back a card I'd already paid as a cost.
review: Aeolipile {1} tap sacrifice activation target opponent White Knight 2/2, two damage after combat lethal, cost paid Plains. Noncreature artifact tap not blocked by summoning sickness; opponent can respond to ability, artifact already gone.
